thread:
Elena: heads-up: noticed a consistent aggregation delta for search-queries index — counts down ~1.8% from 04:05-04:40 UTC. ETL consumers spiked lag and a couple of workers restarted. filing here for follow-up.

obs-bot: alert: ETL lag >10m for topic=spans_ingest, window=30m, threshold=10m. incident=INC-2370 :rotating_light:

Tom: I pulled the consumer metrics. there was a hotspot on partition 12 with sustained 100% CPU on consumer-3 and periodic s3 write 500s. looks like large batches sent to that partition caused backpressure + retries. snippet: 
```
2026-03-21T04:12:22Z WARN consumer[3]: partition=12 fetch_bytes=12.3MB inflight_msgs=2048
2026-03-21T04:12:23Z ERROR sink.s3: PutObject failed status=500 attempt=3 key=ingest/2026/03/21/04/12/part-12
2026-03-21T04:12:24Z INFO consumer[3]: restarting worker due to OOM
```

Maya: sounds like a classic partition skew + oversized producer batches. any sign of producer-side burst?

Elena: yes — client telemetry shows a burst from a mobile client build (v1.14.2) that sent aggregated spans without sharding hints. caused many large messages to land in same partition. sampled payloads have large trace payloads.

Ravi: two-fold problem then: producer causing skew + consumer not resilient to oversized batches. propose we split remediation work: short-term mitigations to stop immediate data loss, medium-term to patch producers + rollout, long-term to harden ETL and alerts.

Sasha: short-term proposals: 1) throttle ingestion for offending client id at the proxy (owner: Elena, ETA: 6h), 2) increase consumer parallelism for partition 12 and temporarily increase max_batch_size on sink (owner: Tom, ETA: 12h).

Tom: I'll open a hotfix to bump consumer count for the affected shard and add a defensive check to drop single-record batches > 8MB (log + metric) so they don't OOM workers. will coordinate with infra for a quick scale-up window.

Maya: medium-term: add producer-side validation to client SDK to enforce per-span max size + ensure sharding hint generation (owner: Sasha, ETA: 3w). also will add a CI check that simulates partition skew to catch regressions.

Elena: long-term: add per-partition health dashboards (lag, p50/p99 sink latency, max_batch_size), and a runbook entry for partition-hotspot incidents (owner: Ravi, ETA: next sprint).

data-analytics: fyi — we saw related dashboard dips for click-through metrics in the 04:10-04:45 window; we'll need a backfill to reconcile counts if backfill is feasible.

Ravi: agree. propose a small compensation job to reprocess raw events for the 1h window from raw-archive if available (owner: Elena + data-analytics, ETA: 48h). prioritize correctness for reporting only (no re-ingest to live pipeline).

Tom: PR opened for hotfix: https://git.redwood.internal/r/etl/consumer-hotfix/pull/89 — includes <8MB drop check + shard-scale script (WIP). requesting quick review.

Sasha: drafting client-sdk change and rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with monitoring on partition skew, p50/p99, and drop-rate. will post detailed rollout in #eng-runtime.

Maya: note on alerts: current threshold is global. recommend a per-partition alert rule (e.g., partition lag > 5m or consumer error rate > 1% for 3m). I'll add these to observability backlog and tune current alert noisemaker.

Ravi: action item summary:
- Elena: throttle offending client at proxy + runbackfill w/ data-analytics (ETA 6h throttle, 48h backfill)
- Tom: consumer scale + defensive drop PR + deploy (ETA 12h)
- Sasha: client SDK validation + rollout plan (ETA 3w)
- Maya: alerting per-partition + CI skew test (ETA next sprint)
- Ravi: runbook + stakeholder comms + prioritize dashboard reconciles (ETA 2d)

Elena: adding a note for customer success — will own any customer outreach if we need to explain delayed metrics.

obs-bot: incident INC-2370 created and linked to postmortem template: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-2370

Ravi: we'll do a 15-min check-in at 6h and a broader follow-up in 48h after the backfill attempt. ping me for escalations. :thumbsup:
